lines.meaning: Time, you tireless servant (lackey) of eternity,

lines.text: With some mischance cross Tarquin in his flight:
lines.meaning: send some bad luck (mischance) to block (cross) Tarquin as he flees,
invent troubles worse than the worst (extremes beyond extremity),

lines.text: To make him curse this cursed crimeful night:
lines.meaning: to make him curse this accursed night of crime,

lines.text: Let ghastly shadows his lewd eyes affright;
lines.meaning: let ghastly shadows frighten (affright) his lustful, wicked (lewd) eyes,

lines.text: And the dire thought of his committed evil
lines.meaning: and let the dreadful (dire) thought of the evil he has done

lines.text: Shape every bush a hideous shapeless devil.
lines.meaning: make every bush look to him, in his guilt, like a hideous, shapeless devil.

summary: Lucrece calls on Time to torment Tarquin as he flees.
